description: This file defines the DbLogController class for handling database log routes in Drupal, including listing logs, viewing log details, and generating log reports.

classes.name: DbLogController
classes.description: Controller class for handling database log routes, including listing logs, viewing details, and generating reports.

methods.name: getLogLevelClassMap
methods.description: Returns an array mapping log levels to CSS classes.

methods.name: overview
methods.description: Displays a list of database log messages with filtering, pagination, and links to details.

methods.name: eventDetails
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific log message identified by event_id.

methods.name: addFilterToQuery
methods.description: Applies session-based filters to a database query for log listing.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a log message, unserializing variables and handling backtrace display.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a Link object if the URI is valid, otherwise returns the URI.

methods.name: topLogMessages
methods.description: Displays the most frequent log messages of a given type.
